name: L10 PanoLab fixed appearance router on target- and collection-unseen positives
question: Does the unchanged four-positive appearance fingerprint and open-set score/margin gate accept two target-way/item-unseen positive queries when their reference images come from different Panoramax collections?

frozen_roster.rule: Rank each fresh query against all six targets. The four prior target banks are unchanged; each new target receives its two frozen reference-collection images.

accept_contract.calibration_source: Minimum correct score and truth margin across the four consumed positive rows in l10_panolab_component_router_result_v1.json.
accept_contract.rule: Emit a SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY candidate only when the unique top-1 score and its top-1-versus-runner-up margin both meet the frozen thresholds; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
accept_contract.no_adaptation: No score, margin, feature weight, crop, model, roster, image, truth label, or threshold may be changed after either fresh result is observed.

execution.models: Reuse the exact local CLIP and DINOv2 artifacts, patch grid, batch size, crop, and 0.35/0.25/0.40 score formula sealed in the base component protocol.
execution.output_policy: Refuse an existing result or output root; preserve the first terminal result.
execution.failure_policy: A failure remains a failure. Do not resample, tune, or rerun a sealed row.

required: both human-reviewed positive rows remain valid
all four new reference views are collection-disjoint from their query
zero item overlap with the prior component-router images
2/2 fresh positives accepted as the correct target
0 accepted wrong targets across the two primary trials
0 wrong-target candidates across 10 counterfactual wrong-goal trials

research_basis.title: Learning Sequential Descriptors for Sequence-based Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates evaluating place representations across distinct traversals. This replay does not implement or claim SeqVLAD.

research_basis.title: JIST: Joint Image and Sequence Training for Sequential Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates cross-sequence descriptor evaluation. This replay does not train or implement SeqGeM.

research_basis.title: SafeVPR: Safe Place Recognition via Open-Set Uncertainty Quantification
research_basis.use: Motivates separating retrieval ranking from accept-or-abstain. This tiny fixed-threshold panel is not conformal risk control or an open-world guarantee.

claim_boundary.allowed: Development evidence for or against the unchanged facade-fingerprint router on exactly two target-way/item-unseen, query-reference-collection-disjoint positive Panoramax episodes, ranked against a six-target closed roster.
not_allowed: provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, or deployment generalization
exact physical identity authority, pixel portal grounding, entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety
learned temporal sequence matching or a production routing policy
